seo_what_desc: A gradient favicon is a small website icon that uses smooth color transitions instead of flat colors. It appears in browser tabs, bookmarks, and mobile home screens. Gradient favicons add a modern, polished look to your website and help your brand stand out among dozens of open tabs.
seo_why_title: Why Use a Gradient Favicon for Your Website?
seo_why_desc: A well-designed favicon strengthens your brand identity and improves user experience. Here's why gradient favicons are a great choice:
seo_why_point1: Stand out in browser tabs — gradient colors catch the eye more than flat solid icons
seo_why_point2: Modern and professional appearance — gradients signal attention to design detail
seo_why_point3: Better brand recognition — unique color combinations make your favicon memorable
seo_why_point4: Works at all sizes — our generator previews your favicon at 16px, 32px, and 64px so it looks great everywhere
seo_how_title: How to Create a Gradient Favicon
seo_how_desc: Using our free gradient favicon generator is simple: 1) Choose a preset style or start from scratch; 2) Customize the three gradient colors — highlight, main, and accent; 3) Select a shape (circle, squircle, or rounded square); 4) Adjust the gradient angle and highlight intensity; 5) Preview at multiple sizes; 6) Download as SVG (vector) or PNG (raster) and add it to your website.
faq1_q: What size should a favicon be?
faq1_a: Modern browsers support multiple favicon sizes. We recommend providing at least 16x16, 32x32, and 180x180 (for Apple Touch Icon). Our generator outputs scalable SVG files that look crisp at any size, plus high-resolution PNG exports.
faq2_q: Can I use this gradient favicon for commercial projects?
faq2_a: Yes! All favicons created with our tool are completely free for personal and commercial use. No attribution required.
faq3_q: What's the difference between SVG and PNG favicon formats?
faq3_a: SVG favicons are vector-based and scale perfectly to any size without losing quality. PNG favicons are raster images with fixed resolution. Modern browsers support SVG favicons, but PNG is more universally compatible. We recommend downloading both.
faq4_q: How do I add a favicon to my website?
faq4_a: Add the following HTML to your page's <head> section: <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg">. Our generator also provides a ready-to-use embed code snippet you can copy directly.
